setupNotes: 1. Create a Firebase project (Spark plan is fine).
3. Create Firestore database (production mode), then deploy firestore.rules from this repo.
4. Add Authorized domains: www.tirthayatraonline.in, tirthayatraonline.in, localhost.
5. Paste web app config into firebase above and set enabled to true.
6. Keep adminEmails as the only Google accounts that can open /admin/feedback.html.
7. Rebuild (python3 build.py) and deploy. Feedback is never published live automatically.
